captions.instagram:
Class 11 Chemistry · Classification of Elements
Chemistry, visualised #2 · Why does the periodic table have families? 🧪

All 118 elements, and 8 families:
🔴 Alkali metals · 1 outer electron, fizz in water
🟠 Alkaline earth metals · 2 outer electrons
🔵 Transition metals · coloured compounds, great catalysts
🟣 Lanthanides · the rare earths
🩷 Actinides · every one is radioactive
🩵 Metalloids · half metal, half non-metal
🟡 Halogens · 7 outer electrons, salt makers
🟢 Noble gases · full outer shell, they don't react

The why: elements in the same column have the same number of outer electrons, so they behave alike.
